title: Monotonicity of reachability invariants
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ and $G'$ be predicates on configurations. If the machine reaches $b$ from $a$ in finitely many steps with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before reaching $b$, and every configuration satisfying $G$ also satisfies $G'$, then it reaches $b$ from $a$ with $G'$ holding at every configuration strictly before reaching $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite run reaches $b$ from $a$ and satisfies $G$ at each earlier configuration
